title: Brenny's Pack
description: A Vanilla+ Modpack aimed at Quality of Life Improvements.
body:
Brenny's Pack is a Vanilla+ Modpack aimed at bringing quality of life improvements to the base game. In its base configuration it is intended for extremely casual players (as it was originally designed for use with the creator's children). Difficulty can be increased via config tweaks.

Specifically, this modpack brings you:

 - 'Complementary Shaders - Unbound' and dependencies
 - CC Tweaked (Computers in Minecraft) and dependencies
 - Waystones
 - Gravestones
 - Minimap and World Map
 - Creeper mob griefing disabled
 - Ore vein harvesting and full tree harvesting
 - The ability to craft netherite items without a smithing template
 - A pocket dimension for easy ore mining
 - Happy Ghast Improvements (increased speed and the ability to stop them from roaming)
 - The ability to bottle your XP for later use
 - The ability to use totems from within your inventory
 - The ability to repair mending items in your inventory
 - The ability to place blocks against the hidden faces of nearby blocks like in Bedrock (easy bridging)
 - A number of mods which make resources drop nearby
 - Several Quality of life mods for elytras (the Ender dragon now drops one on death and they can be merged with a chestplate)
 - Enhanced enchanting via enchanting infusers
 - Better villager trading via re-rolling trades, fast trades, and a trading post.
 - Multiple furniture mods for decorations
 - Several methods of mob suppression (magnum torch and campfires block mobs)
